Chapter 427: Chapter 5 I’m so scared (Please subscribe)

“This is…”

“A mustard seed that can harbor the void?”

Ao Du’s expression was ugly, the scene they were witnessing now, the man standing in the starry sky had turned into a giant that reached up to the heavens and down to the earth.

In fact, the man’s stature had not changed; it was them and the planet beneath their feet that were rapidly shrinking under the compression of the Space Rules.

Such a method could only be mastered by powerful beings with an extremely high understanding of the Space Rules.

...

According to the definition of the Space Rules by human civilization, one must have penetrated at least one thousand eight hundred core space models to do so.

Generally speaking, a powerful being who has penetrated so many core space models would likely be at the peak of the Eighth Rank. Ao Du was familiar with all the peak Eighth-Rank powerhouses in the Milky Way Star Region and the surrounding regions.

But they had never heard of that man in the green armor before?

Ao Du was puzzled, feeling the space force pressing in from all around, which made their scalp tingle.

“It’s the Galaxy Master.”

The massive fleshy mountain nearby recognized him at once.

It was aware of much information about the Galaxy Master, including relevant images, and the current ‘giant’ standing beyond the sky bore a strong resemblance to the Galaxy Master.

Plus the sentence the other party had just said, “Tell me, what do you plan to do if the Galaxy Master dares to come?”

The massive fleshy mountain was almost certain that the other party was the Galaxy Master.

“The Galaxy Master?”

Ao Du was somewhat dazed.

They turned their head to look at the massive flesh mountain with confusion.

Wasn’t it said that the Galaxy Master had newly advanced to the Eighth Rank? How then could he reduce nearly ten million li of planets to mesons with a mere wave of his hand?

This level of spatial comprehension was not something even a peak Eighth-Rank powerhouse might achieve, yet the Galaxy Master, who was just newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, had done it?

“Starry Sky Alliance, Shang Shan, has seen the Galaxy Master.”

The massive fleshy mountain did not pay attention to Ao Du’s disbelief and hastily spoke with a hint of respect.

Although it also found it hard to comprehend how the Galaxy Master could possess such tremendous strength, now was not the time to contend over these matters.

The most important thing was to ease the atmosphere between them.

“Starry Sky Alliance, Ao Du, has seen the Galaxy Master.”

Seeing this, Ao Du also followed suit immediately.

“You special life forms, taking advantage of your noble bloodlines to act recklessly one after another, now this star region is the domain of human civilization, wantonly devouring planets…”

Lin Yuan spoke indifferently, “Do you really think we humans are like the Shadow Tribe?”

The Shadow Tribe, when dealing with these special life forms, was very tolerant: one reason was a reluctance to offend the forces behind these special life forms, and the other was that these special life forms themselves are not easy to deal with.

Thus, normally, the strong ones of the Shadow Tribe would turn a blind eye, such as Ao Du, who enjoyed devouring planets, as long as it was not too excessive, they would not interfere.

“We were wrong, Galaxy Master.”

The color on the massive fleshy mountain’s face changed slightly. Through these words, it sensed that the Galaxy Master was somewhat…

Dissatisfied.

“After today, we will obediently leave and will definitely not appear before the Galaxy Master again.”

The massive fleshy mountain ‘Shang Shan’ immediately said.

Even if the Galaxy Master truly was only newly advanced to the Eighth Rank, upon learning of his attitude, the best choice for the two special life forms was to leave.

After all, as the master of a star region, the Galaxy Master had plenty of ways to deal with them.

Call on friends?

Ask a teacher to intervene?

These were all possibilities.

Moreover, the strength that the Galaxy Master had just displayed was not inferior to that of a peak Eighth-Rank, and his ill will was entirely unbearable for the two special life forms.

“You’ve swallowed so many of my planets, and you think you can just walk away lightly?” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, and with a mere thought, a tremendous force began to press down on the planet in his hand.

Boom.

Terrifying power swept across the surface of the planet. Lin Yuan still held back, otherwise, the planet would have collapsed instantly.

“Not good.”

The massive fleshy mountain’s form suddenly swelled up, struggling to withstand the crushing force from all directions. However, ‘Shang Shan’ had a premonition that it couldn’t hold out for long.

“How can this Galaxy Master be so monstrous? Is this what you call being newly advanced to the Eighth Rank? Is this what you call under a hundred years old?”

The massive fleshy mountain ‘Shang Shan’ felt bitterly distressed.

It looked at Ao Du not far away, who had been forced to reveal their true form,

But under the Galaxy Master’s mustard seed technique, Ao Du’s true form was only the size of a little finger, devoid of all the majesty of a special life form, and instead seemed somewhat cute.

“Galaxy Master.”

After struggling for over a dozen breaths, the massive fleshy mountain life form ‘Shang Shan’ once again spoke, “I am willing to pay twenty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals to compensate for the loss of the Star Lord.”

The massive fleshy mountain life was inwardly bitter.

Most of the planets it had devoured were during the time when the Shadow Tribe ruled this star region, but there was nothing it could do, as now everything was decided by the Galaxy Master.

“I am willing as well.”

Ao Du also said.

They were also finding it hard to hold on.

“Twenty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the two special life forms.

A normal Eighth-Rank powerhouse might possess a number of Universe Crystals ranging from a few thousand to ten thousand.

Human beings who advanced to the Eighth Rank were somewhat wealthier, but not by much, at most just over ten thousand.

But these two special life forms were willing to cough up twenty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals straightaway, clearly quite wealthy.

This was understandable, as special life forms had long lifespans and many talents and abilities, which over the long years accumulated to make each of them excessively rich.

“What do you say, Galaxy Master.”

“Twenty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals should be enough to compensate you,” said the massive fleshy mountain life form ‘Shang Shan,’ bleeding inwardly. It had cultivated the Doppelganger Skill, and its true body was in a distant star domain, but even so, this doppelganger that it had refined over many years nearly matched its true body in combat power.
